details.storageInstructions:
Storage Instructions: 
Store in a cool, dry place
Protect from moisture and direct sunlight
Keep the pack tightly closed after use
Uses:
For a wellness drink, mix 1 teaspoon of amla powder with warm water, juice, smoothies, or honey water and consume as desired
For a hair mask, combine the powder with curd, aloe vera gel, coconut oil, or water to form a smooth paste. Apply to the hair and scalp, leave for 20-30 minutes, and rinse thoroughly

details.description: Experience the goodness of traditional hair care with The Old Natural Rajasthani Henna Powder, made from premium-quality henna leaves sourced for rich colour and effective hair nourishment. Known for its natural conditioning properties, this herbal mehndi powder helps add a beautiful natural tint while supporting stronger, healthier-looking hair. Ideal for regular hair care routines, this multipurpose henna powder helps improve hair texture, reduce dullness, and nourish the scalp naturally. It works as a natural hair conditioning treatment that leaves hair looking soft, shiny, and manageable. Perfect for men and women looking for a natural alternative for hair colour, hair care and scalp nourishment.
details.usageInstructions:
Mix the required amount of Henna Powder with water, black tea, or coffee solution to form a thick, lump-free paste
Cover the mixture and leave it aside for 6-8 hours (or overnight) to allow the natural dye to release
Apply the paste thoroughly to clean, dry hair, starting from the roots and working towards the tips
Leave the paste on for 3-4 hours
Rinse hair thoroughly with plain water until all paste is removed. Avoid shampoo for the next 24-48 hours for best colour retention

details.description: Bring home the power of nature with The Old Natural Multani Mitti Powder, a pure and natural Fuller's Earth powder traditionally trusted for deep cleansing, oil control, tan removal, and scalp purification. Rich in natural minerals, this fine-quality Multani Mitti helps to absorb excess oil, dirt, and impurities from the skin while leaving your face feeling fresh, smooth, and naturally radiant. Perfect for oily skin, acne-prone skin, dull skin, and greasy scalp care, this versatile powder can be used as a face pack, tan removal pack, scalp detox mask, and natural exfoliator. It gently removes dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and supports clearer-looking skin without harsh chemicals. Made with 100% pure Multani Mitti, this powder is free from artificial colours, synthetic fragrance, ammonia, and preservatives, making it suitable for regular skincare and haircare routines. Use with rose water, curd, aloe vera gel, or water to create DIY face packs and hair masks for salon-like care at home.
details.usageInstructions:
Face Pack for Dry Skin
Take Multani Mitti in a clean bowl and mix it with honey and
a few drops of rose water to make a smooth paste. Apply evenly to a clean face
and neck. Leave it on for 15–20 minutes. Rinse gently with lukewarm water and
apply a light moisturiser.
Hair Benefits
Multani Mitti gently cleanses the scalp without harsh
chemicals and helps control excess oil build-up. It supports a clean and
refreshed scalp, assists in reducing dandruff caused by an oily scalp, and
leaves the hair feeling light and naturally clean.
Tan Removal Face Pack
Combine Multani Mitti with rose water and a small amount of
liquorice (mulethi) powder. Apply a thin layer to the face and exposed areas.
Leave it on for 15–20 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with cool water.

details.description: Boost your daily nutrition naturally with The Old Natural Organic Moringa Powder, made from carefully selected moringa leaves that are gently dried and finely processed to help preserve their natural nutritional value. Known as a highly valued Ayurvedic superfood, moringa is naturally rich in vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, plant-based protein, and dietary fibre that support overall well-being. This versatile green powder blends easily into smoothies, warm water, juices, soups, salads, and shakes, making it a convenient addition to your daily routine. Whether you are seeking a natural source of nourishment, support for a healthy lifestyle, or plant-based nutrition, this moringa powder is an excellent choice. Made with pure moringa leaf powder and free from artificial colours, synthetic fragrances, and harmful chemicals, The Old Natural delivers clean, natural goodness in every scoop.
details.storageInstructions:
Storage:
Store in a cool, dry place away from moisture and direct sunlight
Keep the pack tightly closed after each use to maintain freshness and quality
Uses:
For a morning wellness drink, mix 1 teaspoon of moringa powder into warm water or lemon water. It can also be blended into smoothies and protein shakes for a convenient source of green superfood nutrition
For everyday meals, sprinkle it over soups, curries, salads, and healthy bowls. Moringa powder may also be mixed with herbal tea or wellness drinks as part of your daily routine
For a nutritious breakfast, add it to oats, dosa batter, smoothies, or energy bowls

details.description:

Plant-Based & Naturally Sourced - Made from a pure plant-based ingredient with no synthetic fragrances, ammonia, or harsh chemical processing
Supports Skin & Wellness Hydration - A popular traditional ingredient used in cooling wellness recipes to support hydration and skin nourishment

details.usageInstructions:
Soak the required amount of Gond Katira in water for a few hours or overnight
Once fully swollen, it will turn into a soft jelly-like form
Add lemon juice, rose syrup, or your favourite natural sweetener
Serve chilled for a refreshing drink
